label: Meridian Station
summary: A research station in orbit around a storm-banded gas giant, three months from the nearest port.

world.setting: Meridian, a ring-shaped research station orbiting the gas giant Halcyon
world.description: Forty crew, one hydroponics deck that smells like basil, a canteen that runs out of coffee on Thursdays, and an observation lounge where the planet fills every window. The supply ship comes once a season.
rules: Grounded science fiction: no aliens, no faster-than-light messages
The station's systems are reliable but old, and everyone takes a maintenance shift
Romance develops slowly and only with mutual interest
